nom: Benefit Cosmetics The POREfessional Good Cleanup Foaming Cleanser

avis.texte: I love this face wash! It removes my makeup and my pores do appear smaller. I have only been using it for a couple weeks and can see a difference.

Such a great hydrating face wash! I love this face wash, i had skme of my doubts but like i loved it. Super easy to control the face wash by adding as much water as you want to make it foam in a way like frothy. Super duper great product!! And yes i do have SUPER dry skin but this is for the dry skin people!!

I love love this product! It takes off almost all my makeup, including my waterproof makeup, it has a nice clean smell, it does not leave my face feeling dry and it plays nice with all the rest of my skincare routine! 10/10 will repurchase always!!

I love this product so much! It gets all my makeup off, even most of my waterproof makeup, it has next to no scent, it leaves my face feeling clean and not dry and it plays well with all the rest of my skin routine!! Definitely a repurchase!
The cleanser is great, but the pump bottle is so poor and annoying that I won't be buying it again.

avis.titre: Made My Face Red Itchy And Scaly
avis.texte: I'm writing this for anybody that might have the same issue as me and doesn't know why. I started using this a month ago. I got a dry spot around my nose after about 2 weeks of use, didn't connect it was the cleanser because I changed some makeup and moisturizer as well. My skin started to get red and scaly all around my nose and mouth to the point I thought somehow I'd developed psoriasis or something. Then the red, itchy scaly skin started appearing around my eyes. I have been changing each part of my skincare routine one at a time trying to find the cause. Finally chucked this cleanser and within 3 days my skin is looking healthier but still a lot of damage to undo. DEFINITELY wouldn't recommend for anybody with sensitive skin.
I have used it for 3 years and my pores are still so so clogged.. I continue to use it because it suds up nice and doesn't make me breakout but as far as cleaning pores out... I dont think it has
I use this after the cleansing oil and my face always feels so soft and clean. Ive been using this for about 3 weeks and i havent experienced any irritation or breakouts. I have very sensitive skin.
i got a mini sample of this from ulta and it sucks. i love everything else from benefit i've used but the texture of this 🤮. it's thinner than water. do not recommend.

avis.titre: It's the only cleanser that makes me feel clean!
avis.texte: Other cleansers make me feel greasy. Not this one. I love it and the price is right!

It really helped tighten up my pores and I felt clean after use. You do have to take a hot shower for your pores to open otherwise it'll just sit there. Occasionally though I would feel a burning sensation but it's not that often to where it's concerning

Washing my face with this product has left my face feeling so much better! I hated having my pores look so big when using makeup but this product leaves my face looking and feeling so great and my pore size has shrunk quite a bit! Really loving it so far!

Oddly, my cleanser doesn't bubble at all. After cleansing, my face feels dry like I used soap. The rest of my skincare routine made up for the dryness, thankfully. It diesn't feel healthy for your skin.
This stuff works. I have used it over a week and can really tell a difference.
I can only use this as an exfoliator because I have dry skin but this has my skin purging so much and I love it!!!!

I have dry and very sensitive skin, this product said that it was sutable for those skin types, after the first time I used it i am not going to lie my skin did feel very refreshed, after i started using it daily around day 3 my skin become so dry it started cracking and bleeding on my face, mostly around my nose and mouth, i didnt even suspect that it was the face wash but i stopped doing my skin care altogether to let my face heal and if i did do my skin care it would burn my face so bad, after my skin healed which took about 3-4 weeks, i went back to doing my skincare which means i started using this face wash again, and after the 1st use my skin the next day was starting to peel again, and the day after that it was cracked and bleeding, they say this product does not strip you skin layer but I honestly think it does, so if you have sensitive dry skin like me i am telling you, stay away from this product.

avis.titre: THE BEST & I'm picky about cleansers!
avis.texte: My skin is super super sensitive and i struggle with trying new skincare because of that, especially with how expensive everything is these days. Ive been using this cleanser for almost a year now and it's the best thing that's ever touched my face. If you struggle with textrure or acne, this will make a significant difference. Whenever i get pimples and use this cleanser it reduces the size of them overnight. I always pair it with a spot treatment and a pimple patch to speed up the process. I never write reviews but this product deserved one. 10/10!!!

It does what you need it to do, and it doesn't take a lot of product to get the job done. I wouldnt say I have the most sensitive skin but it can be quite picky about cleansers, and this one passes the test
this cleared up my textured face so well, got rid of the bumps all over my forehead, lightweight and smelles amazing +super easy to use

i really like this product. its nice and gentle. ive been using it for a few weeks and have started to notice a difference in my skin. its so smooth, i hardly get any blemishes. i bought the mini but now i'm probably going to get the regular size. it works great!

I am so disappointed in this product and entire line. It does absolutely nothing for you skin, it honestly makes it worse. Customer service refused to accept my return even though Product is almost full. The good reviews are 100% from paid influencers. Don't buy into the hype like I did. Embarrassing

Amazing cleanser. Definitely going to be a repurchase. Your skin feels so much cleaner after and you only really need the smallest dot. It's so fresh feeling. I love it and will recommend to anyone looking for a new cleanser.

Amazing cleanser. Definitely going to be a repurchase. Your skin feels so much cleaner after and you only really need the smallest dot. It's so fresh feeling. I love it and will recommend to anyone looking for a new cleanser.
It works wonders. It is sudsy and you only need a dot to do it. It cleans your pores and closes them up nicely. I love it.

This face wash works wonders for my skin. My face has never been softer and my skin looks so clear! And when it comes to minimizing and cleaning pores, it definitely does its job well. I love it so much!

I've been trying so many pore/blackhead skincare regimens. I got a mini sample of this and the charcoal mask and my skin hasnt looked this good in forever! My blackheads have dimished immensely and my pores look so much cleaner and healthier. I will be buying the full size products once my minis run out.
Just what you'd expect from benefit: perfection in a bottle. My skin is so smooth and healthy after using this. Highly recommend

My pores are visibly smaller after using this cleanser without skin irritation or breakouts. The scent takes some getting used to - it's kind of medicinal , but after a while I began to love the scent. Just a little bit of this cleanser goes a long way.

Gifted by benefit cosmetics. Need a new cleanser that isn't too harsh on the skin? This is the one! I love how a small portion is needed and how it bubbles up easily. The scent is very light, not too strong. I Can see how the cleaner helps with my oily skin.
this is gentle, but effective. leaves face clean and smooth. foams up nicely
Leaves my skin very clean, helps keeps pores clear. Has a great smell and lovely formula. You don't need a lot.

In all of my years struggling with big pores and cystic acne this was a godsend for me! I have tried everything out there to help with my skin. I am 36 and since my late teen years, sadly I have never had clear skin. I tried this in a sample size that was suggested by a consultant working the makeup counter and it has absolutely changed my life. By the time I finished the sample size (about 2 months) my skin was clear. Even my family and friends noticed. I have been out for about two weeks and the acne has returned. I am ordering more ASAP! I will never go without this cleanser again!
I'm typing skeptical of "poor shrinking" anything but this feels so clean and perfect… I absolutely love it.

Gives a nice clean feeling. Doesn't dry your skin out either. I normally get dry patches from most face wash but this actually gives a little hydration. I've been able to go without foundation since using this product.
It's gentle on my face, the scent is pleasant. I will buy it in a bigger bottle for sure!

Product does not really lather up or foam. I have to use like 4-5 pumps to get this cleaner to lather up and definitely doesnt foam as is clains. Face does not even feel clean after one use especially after wearing makeup. When compared to other products I used this is by far my least favorite cleaner ive ever purchased. I had high hope for this but I will not be repurchasing.
I use the cleansing wand with this and it cleans my face so well. I love how my skin feels after using this. I definitely do notice a difference with the pore size
Product does not really lather up or foam. Pump is cheap. Face does not even feel cleaned compared to other products used.

I highly recommend this facial wash partnered with the toner. I've been using them every morning and it has improved my skin. I'm also a big fan of Benefit Cosmetics because of the quality and accessibility. This product is complimentary from Benefit Cosmetics.
Already bought a backup! You only need one or two pumps. A little goes a long way. Product gets skin clean without drying and no soapy residue. Highly recommended.
I do like this face wash, it is light and does not leave your skin feeling dry. Obsessed with the packaging.
I have already purchased again. Just love this cleanser. No residue! Didn't dry out my skin. Felt so refresh after every use!
Only used a few times so far but it leaves my skin feeling smooth and clean BONUS is a little amount goes a long way

This product is my new favorite cleanser hands DOWN! It's so gentle on the skin and my skin doesn't feel dried out afterwards. My skin feels very soft and the clogged pores i've been dealing with are FINALLY going away. It's not an overwhelming smell (and to me it smells really good) and it lathers super easy. 100% worth the price point, as it does what it says and does it well.
I really love this cleanser. It makes my skin feel smooth and clean. It has a nice light scent. My only complaint is that this is not a foaming cleanser at all.

I use this product when I showered and a little goes a long way I only used about 1 1/2 pumps and it worked really well. I definitely will be using this product and my skin care routine and when I shower.

Really enjoying this cleanser so far! I love the smell and it's super easy to get the foam (which I love!!). The mousse texture is perfect for daily use, especially on casual weekends. It's easy to rinse off too, won't leave weird feeling in your face!

Loved the face wash, i need more time to use it and see even more results but i feel my skin much smoother and clearer. My pores dont get as clogged as they usually do and less dirt around my nose!! Will keep using

Got this gifted to try it out. I am excited because I ran out of my previous cleanser from a different brand. So far, it's not harsh on the skin, light and foams. It does not dry out my skin and I have a combination of skin so I was worried about that. Been trying it the last couple of days and I'm excited to see how it turns out for my skin.

I received this complimentary from Benefit Cosmetics. This is a great daily cleanser for combination skin. Since it's a foam, it is hydrating but also gets the job done at making sure the skin is nice and clean!

This is such a good cleanser if you don't want some thing to be so stripping but you want to feel clean. Still the fact that it's a foaming cleanser means that you won't really be able to use it with dry skin but with oily skin this is the perfect thing for you.

Great cleanser! I enjoyed trying this product among the entire product line, it did feel like it cleaned deep into my pores because of the foaming affect! Foaming cleaners are definitely my favorite too!

This product was given to me complimentary from Benefit Cosmetics. I really liked the scent of it, it was apparent enough but not too fragrant where it irritated my skin. It foamed nicely too and left my skin on my face feeling clean but not dry. Looking forward to seeing how it works for me over the next couple weeks.

This smells heavenly! I like the packaging although it gets dented pretty easily if you drop it. But overall the performance of the formula is good, it cleanse my skin without being stripping! I'm excited to see what other skincare products will be added over time

This cleanser is my favorite to use after the cleansing oil. Those 2 products used together leave my skin feeling super clean and refreshed. And It doesn't feel dry afterwards. My pores look super clear afterwards.

This is a great facial cleanser. I have been a fan of benefit cosmetics for years and I was excited to try their skin care. It is gentle she cleans my skin very well. It did not dry my skin out like some do

I love the packaging it comes in, the cleanser it self is alright, it reminded me of this one drug store cleanser I used to use in middle school, just the smell and texture did. Although I don't use it everyday but I do like how it cleans

I've been using this for a few days and I'm obsessed. I can tell there's a difference in my skin, I feel like it almost evened out my skin tone while also reducing my pore size. GET THIS and the makeup remover too!

complimentary from Benefit Cosmetics. I recently tried this Pore Cleanser, and I have to say, it's one of the best pore cleansers I've used. The product was easy to apply and had a cooling effect on my skin, which was a nice touch. After leaving it on for about 2 minutes and rinsing it off, my pores felt noticeably cleaner and my skin felt smoother overall. I also appreciate that it didn't dry out my skin like some other pore cleansers can. Overall, I highly recommend this product to anyone looking for a reliable and effective pore cleanser.

love love love. i used this product for a week so far and i have no complaints. i have sensitive and combo skin and this has worked great. it doesn't leave my skin feeling tight and dry. i also feel like my skin is clear of all dirt and makeup from the day. overall 10/10

The formula of this product cleansed my skin without the dry feeling you get after using a cleanser that's too harsh. My skin's pH felt very balanced and it was a great addition to my overall skincare routine!

Complimentary by benefit and I really like it, is gentle but works very good, I alternate it with acne cleanser and it's gentle enough to do so, I have been using it for two weeks and will definitely recommend

I love this cleanser because it gives me a good wash while minimizing my pores. This is highly important because I get less breakouts the more I continue using. I only wash day and night and im happy to have my hands on this! so happy that I was gifted by benefit cosmetics.

Good product! I like using it after I remove my makeup as the second step of a double cleanse. It does not strip the natural moisture from my face and leaves my skin feeling hydrated and soft. There is also a light scent, but I don't mind! This product was gifted by Benefit.

As soon as I got it put it on my shower. Love this foaming cleanser, great size and you need really little to wash your face, I use on my back too. Smells great, not too much. I would recommend this product!

I'm a huge foam cleanser fan & this one is going on my good shelf. I used it for a week in the morning and night and it's made my skin feel smoother around my nose area where my pores have started getting more noticeable recently. When I first got this I was hoping it would fix that a bit and it has! I'm so happy with this cleanser!

I'm a huge foam cleanser fan & this one is going on my good shelf. I used it for a week in the morning and night and it's made my skin feel smoother around my nose area where my pores have started getting more noticeable recently. When I first got this I was hoping it would fix that a bit and it has! I'm so happy with this cleanser!

I was scared to use this product because I thought it was going to be heavy and leave a sticky residue because it was foam, but surprisingly it did not. It went on thin. I have only used it for a week but I like it so far. I'd continue to evaluate it and use it and see how it effects my pores. So far so good. complimentary from benefit cosmetics.

I used this after using the get unlocked cleansing oil and my skin felt hydrated and suple. I love that this cleanser is foamy. It's very light weight on the face and not rough at all. My skin felt clean and my pores appeared smaller.

This is a really nice cleanser. I normally avoid foaming cleansers as they tend to dry out my skin, but this one is gentle, doesn't strip the skin, and leaves you feeling fresh and clean. It works wonders after using the cleansing oil for the perfect double cleanse.

The POREfessional Good Cleanup Foaming Cleanser was a nice cleansing formula that felt light weight and clean, but I didn't notice any significant changes to my skin. I didn't like the pump that was on the cleanser, it made it hard for the product to come out. It also has a heavy scent which I try to avoid in cleansers. It did feel nice and remove makeup well though.

Cleanser that works well as a second step of double cleasning routine. It has a gel texture at first, however once it contsact wit hwater it gets foamy and does a good job of removing dirt, makeup, etc. My face feels clean without dry feeling. Kindly gifted by Benefit Cosmetics.

I have blackheads mainly on my nose and chin but I get them throughout my face and this has really helped to clear that up! This product has made my skin feel so smooth and clean! I highly recommend this product to everyone!

Such a great cleanser. Works well with my sensitive skin, doesn't irritate or break me out. Makes my skin look and feel amazing. Feels velvety. My pores have never looked better after using these products

I was gifted by Benefit Cosmetics. Foaming cleansers are my favorite to use. I loved how this product lathered - lots of bubbles - and the scent was very light. smelled lightly of lemons. Only a little bit is needed for use. My face felt clean and refreshed after using. It's a great everyday cleanser.

This cleanser is the best! After using for around 7days, my pores have shrunk, many blackheads went away, and some redness around my chin and nose area. I love the lemon-citrus scent and the packaging is adorable. But I truly love that this product worked for me since I have combination skin. Hydrates the skin!

This product changed my life. I was full of acne and big pores, and together with the other for the same line, my skin was smoother, and my pores were disappearing with time. My favorite part about this cleanser is that it is in gel which makes it easy to apply.

I was gifted by Benefit Cosmetics the professional good cleanup cleanser and I love how lightweight the gel is on my skin. It is easy to use and it lathers into a bubbly foam removing dirt, oil, and impurities. Super fun to use and does not irritate my skin. My pores look managed and not larger.

Love this foaming wash takes my makeup off very well.great also for cleansing after gym . Very gentle for my sensitive skin and love the packaging it comes in as well very cute. Gifted by benefit cosmetics

I love using this cleanser every night to remove the day's gunk. The foaming amount is perfect and leaves my skin feeling so refreshed! There is a subtle citrus smell that makes the cleanser even better!

If your looking for a good cleanser, this is it! I highly recommend this cleanser to all my friends and family because it's one of the best I have seen so far! Just in one cleanse, it removed all my heavy makeup!!

avis.titre: Great for AM and PM Use
avis.texte: This cleanser has been great to use both day and night. I typically cleanse my skin in the AM and PM, so twice a day and this cleanser does not over dry my skin. I feel refreshed and clean. I like the sleek packaging and application.

This cleanser is my new fav. It truly leaves your skin feeling clean and not greasy while seemingly not stripping away any nutrients from the skin. In my experience, I can tell that my pores are more tight and minimized, and I will continue to repurchase! - gifted by Benefit Cosmetics

A gentle everyday foaming cleanser. I liked that it doesn't leave the face feeling tight or stripped. It has a nice lather to it and gets the job done. I like to use it in the morning since it's gentle.
This was a great foaming cleanser! It pairs nicely with the Benefit oil makeup remover. It really does get into the skin and gives a nice clean. My skin feels great!!!

This cleanser is a game changer. I really like this product specifically because it does not burn my eye when trying to get it off make up from my eyelids. I will definitely be using this for a while.

I love this wash and how my skin feels afterwards. I am able to see a difference after using it for 1 week. I would absolutely recommend this product. This wash has helped my skin improve in regard to breakouts.

This new forming cleaners is amazing, I love how it helps tightens my pores. My skin is left feeling refreshed after using, its very lightweight and easy to use. I like that it can be used on all skin types

I loved using the benefit cosmetics cleanser! It was super foamy and fun to apply. It made it easy to remove my makeup. It didn't irritate my skin which is great since I have sensitive skin. Would definitely recommend.

The gel moisturizer in the blue packaging didn't impress me all that much, but this cleanser I quite like! My skin did not feel tight at all after using this, and I usually don't like foaming cleansers for drying out my skin. It comes out as a gel and foams up with friction/use. Received complimentary from Benefit Cosmetics for Review

This cleanser was gifted by Benefit cosmetics. I am in love with this cleanser now, I really feel like this gives my skin a true deep cleanse especially on the days that I wear makeup. It is very gentle on my skin and doesn't make my feel dry or irritated after. I have sensitive skin and haven't had any breakouts. Definitely in my new favorite rotation.

I have been testing out the POREfessional Good Cleanup Foaming Cleanser for a few weeks. This product was sent to me complimentary for review fro Benefit. This product left my skin feeling clean without stripping it or leaving it dry. It has a light scent. Overall, I would recommend this product.

I use this following the oil cleanser and using these together is a game changer. I don't think you could do just one without the other. I have oily skin and I wear sunscreen daily so I've always struggled with finding a cleanser that is successful in removing it but this does the trick

avis.titre: Love it and will continue to purchase!
avis.texte: I received this good cleanup foaming cleanser complimentary from Benefit Cosmetics in exchange for my honest review. I am a huge fan of this cleanser. It has a great foamy lather and it smells amazing. It's very gentle and does not dry out my skin. I use it after I use the new makeup removing oil also from Benefit. They are a fantastic double cleanse team when used together. I would absolutely recommend this cleanser to anyone, with any skin type. And I recommend using it with the oil :)

This cleanser is awesome! It has a very lovely smell, it's gentle and little goes a long way. But what is the most impressive part about it — it actually tightens pores a lot! I have larger pores on my nose and they became super smooth even after just one use. Try it!

I have sensitive skin and I have used this wash a few times and I have had no break outs! It feels like it cleans my skin but not too much that it strips it! Plus I do love the tin packaging. Gifted by Benefit.

I'm so happy to see Benefit Cosmetics has launched a pore targeting skincare line. As someone who needs all the help they can get for their pores this is it. Because I have larger pores, makeup tends to get stuck. So I need a really good gentle yet effective cleanser that will really help my skin. This cleanser is so good! It also smells really good. When I read that it was a foaming cleanser, I thought it was going to be foamy to begin with, however it has a gel consistency. You then use water to activate the product. Massaging the gel cleanser on to your skin is what turns it foamy. After washing my skin, it feels super clean but it does not feel dry or stripped. I really enjoy using this cleanser at night during my double cleanse in my skincare routine.

I received this for free from benefit cosmetics. I actually really enjoyed this foaming cleanser. Normally they tend to dry my skin out but I found that this wasn't to stripping and was actually quite gentle on the skin

My current fav cleanser!!! I been using this cleanser for a week now and I absolutely love it!! It's super lightweight and a little goes along way, foams up and isn't irritating to the skin, my skin has seriously never looked this good. I really like that it's pretty much scentless and leaves my skin super refreshed!!!

Start with this cleanser and pair it with the toner for visibly smaller pores! Love this cleanser and how it makes my skin feel after using it! If you want something refreshing this ones for you. Gifted by Benefit Cosmetics

I'm obsessed with this product! I was nervous about the scent at first but it's so light and refreshing. It takes a little water to foam up and leaves my skin soft and clean. A great everyday product!

The POREfessional Good Cleanup Foam Cleanser Pore-purifying foaming cleanser. This is such a great cleanser to use on a daily basis. So gentle on my sensitive skin and I can already tell the difference. My skin is vey clear

This is my holy grail of facial cleansers! I love the moisturizing and fresh feeling of this. It is great on my sensitive skin and is non-drying. It visibly reduces the appearance of my pores and I've gotten so many compliments on my skin since using this product!

Foaming cleanser is my favorite! I feel so clean after but I don't feel like my skin is drying out. I've been using this cleanser for over 2 weeks and I can't get enough of it. And my pores are super clean.

Gifted by benefit cosmetics. Love love love this cleanser. A small pump can be used foe your whole face. The foam lather is really nice and really makes you feel like you got all the dirty and any makeup left over from the makeup remover. The scent isnt too much but its pleasant. Id definitely love to have this in my skincare routine permanently.

This is a citrus cleanser that is light and effective. It definitely gets rid of the appearance of my pores, however it also leaves my skin feeling a bit tight too so if you have dry skin I'd limit this one to morning use only. Gifted by benefit cosmetics

This is the first time I've tried a product like this! From the first time I tried it I loved it!!! I love how effective it is in removing impurities and at the same time leaving my face looking like it's out of a magazine!

First of all I appreciate the recycling packaging, with this cleanser a little goes a long way, it foams up really well. Unlike other that I have to add a good amount to get some foam going. This cleanser does a great job at removing my mascara and the rest of my make up in the first wash. Leaves my skin feeling nice and cleanse with out feeling dry.

avis.titre: 10/10 WOULD RECOMMEND ALREADY BOUGHT A BACKUP!
avis.texte: I received this product complimentary from Benefit Cosmetics, but i am always honest in my reviews, i loved this cleanser so much i ended up going to pick up another AND even the new cleansing oil it pairs with! I've tried a bunch of cleansers but this one in specifically blew my mind because it visibly helped with my pores! i have really big visible pores and i noticed a difference after 2 weeks of using this that when i apply my makeup it looks smoother! It goes on as a gel and lathers into a foam, it does NOT leave my skin feeling dry after using and you can even close the pump to the side and product doesn't spill (useful if you have curious toddlers like me) It does have a scent, but it's slight and smells good (i would describe it as a slight baby shampoo scent) i have sensitive skin and it did not bother me or irritate my skin. This is by far the first product i've reviewed that i win continue to repurchase. 10/10 would highly recommend!

Love a good foaming cleanser that does the job! Would definitely repurchase this item as it does a good job removing makeup without overly stripping and drying my skin. Packaging is also great and lightweight.

I have an issue with large pores so I was really excited to try this cleanser. I love that this cleanser is a foam, a little bit went a long way. The packaging is also super cute! It did a good job cleaning my face and left my skin feeling great.

I loved this cleanser! It honestly was super easy to lather and foam up. It gets the leftover makeup on your face. I've been using it for a few weeks and my skin seems to really like it! I would definitely recommend.

This cleanser is gentle on my skin, smells amazing, and gets me clean. I usually avoid fragrance in skincare products because they tend to irritate my skin, but this one didn't. This was gifted by Benefit Cosmetics.

First off I love the packaging on this product and how recyclable it is. The cleanser has a very delicate scent and a nice level of thickness that then foams up slightly when massaged of a wet face. Pairs well with the oil based cleanser for a great double cleanse

This pore-purifying foaming cleanser is perfect for those with oily or combination skin. Its gentle formula effectively removes dirt, oil, and impurities, leaving the skin feeling clean and refreshed. Its foaming action provides a luxurious cleansing experience, and it's easy to rinse off. It's a great option for anyone seeking a reliable and effective cleanser that helps to improve the appearance of their skin.

I haven't been using this product very long, but I like it so far! It's lightweight and refreshing, and does not dry out my face which I was nervous about. Also the packaging is super cute! I'm excited to keep using it.

Oh my god!! This cleanser has an amazing texture!! It is super foamy and easy to apply. It leaves my skin so clean, fresh and hydrated!! Also I could notice that my skin is looking more healthy and soft than ever.
